verdict.rationale: Capacities documents a Full Export in Settings that can also run on an automated schedule. The export turns properties into front matter (implying Markdown files), stores collections as CSV, and is described as both human- and machine-readable. That covers on-demand, whole-space export in open formats. Missing for 10: explicit confirmation that media files and links/backlinks survive the full export, and independent or hands-on corroboration of export fidelity.
